`math-symbol.wmf` is a project-generated Windows Metafile fixture. It sets a 200 × 100 logical window, selects a 26-unit Symbol font, writes the legacy bytes `a+b` (Unicode α+β), and draws a horizontal line. It contains no third-party document content.

`tests/Writer.Tests/Fixtures/docx/wmf-preview.docx` embeds those same 136 bytes as an OLE preview. Its XML packaging was normalized by the Open XML SDK for the repository's no-change fidelity checks.
